ma.chooseImage(Object object)

Select an image from the local album or takes a photo using the camera.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
count Number 9 No Maximum number of images that can be selected.
sizeType Array ['original', 'compressed'] No Size of the selected image (supported only by iOS).
sourceType Array ['album', 'camera'] No Source of the selected image. (This function does not apply to the simulator does not take effect.)
desc String No Purpose information. This parameter will be displayed in the permission popup.（Added in 26.6.0-LG0001）
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Valid Values of object.sourceType

Parameter
Value Description Remarks
album Selects images from the album. The album is directly called for image selection if this parameter is set.
camera Uses the camera. The camera is directly called for photographing if this parameter is set.

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String chooseImage:ok
tempFilePaths Array List of local temporary file paths of images.
tempFileVirtualPaths Array Content URI corresponding to the real path.
tempFiles Array List of images stored in local paths temporarily.

Structure of res.tempFiles

Parameter
Attribute Type Description
path String Local temporary file path.
size Number Size of a local temporary file, in byte.

Sample Code

ma.chooseImage({
  count: 1,
  sizeType: ['original', 'compressed'],
  sourceType: ['album', 'camera'],
  desc: '',
  success(res) {
    // tempFilePath can be used as the src attribute of the img tag to display images.
    const tempFilePaths = res.tempFilePaths;
  }
});
